> 第一章 重生巧遇（第1页）
刺耳的急刹声音响起，地面被拖出长长的黑痕。
汽车速度急降，但还是撞在了殷东的身上，撞得他飞了出去。
随即，殷东睁开眼睛，茫然四顾，发现周围环境很是熟悉，赫然是他离开多年的家乡白山镇！
“我不是死了吗？怎么回了老家？”
殷东喃喃说着，再看自己身上穿的竟也是土掉渣的化纤料子的运动服。
他一个激灵坐起来，急忙一摸裤兜，掏出手机打开，眼睛死死盯着屏幕上的时间和日期——二零零八年五月三号！
“这真的不是在做梦吗？我重生了？”
望着屏保上可爱的婴儿照片，尘封的记忆顿时席卷而来，殷东视线不由模糊了。
当年心爱妻子阿夏抛夫弃子不告而别？
亲生儿子被听信二婶鬼话的奶奶视作灾星，被她们卖掉？
这种种痛苦和遗憾甚至都成了他的心魔！
“坏了，今天不就是儿子小宝被偷走的日子吗？小宝！”
殷东脑子里闪过一个可怕的念头，眼眶发红，猛的一挺身站了起来。
美女车主下车来看情况，刚问完，看到殷东猛的站起来，又吓得倒退两步，紧张的说：“你你你……咳咳，我送你去医院吧？”
殷东现在就想去找儿子，没心思找车主麻烦，说完正要走，一抬头就看到对方的脸，顿时跟电击了一样。
这女人白皙的瓜子脸，大大的杏眼，一张嘴不说话总像是在笑着……太熟悉了，让他魂牵梦萦绕的那么多年！
殷东发懵了，这幸福会不会来得太突然了？
前世他离开这个伤心之地后，苦寻妻儿多年，始终未果。

难道，她一直都留在白山镇，并没有离开过？
美女车主本要上前搀扶殷东，却不想殷东一下子就抱住了自己，顿时大惊。
“阿夏，你终于回来了，我好想你——”
她呆了呆，旋即怒火噌一下冒出来，用力一踩殷东脚背，借机挣脱出来，连连后退。
“阿夏，你不认识我了？我是你的老公殷东啊！”
“我叫秋莹，才不是什么见鬼的阿夏。
诶，我就当你是认错人，别过来啊，不然我报警了！”
秋莹发现周围没什么人，本要发飙来着，迟疑一下后还是决定算了。
她狼狈地钻上车，迅速打方向盘想要开走——反正这疑似的家伙也没被撞伤，还是不要继续纠缠下去为好。
“虽然气质和说话语气确实不一样，可长得一模一样啊！”
殷东抓扯着头发，脑子里一连串的疑问冒出来。
他还记得，前世就是因为失忆，阿夏才会无家可归地被自家收留，然后日久生情……想到这里，他猛的一拍脑袋，“先不管了，救小宝要紧！”
他拉开车门，也迅速钻进了车里，坐到副驾驶的座位上。
“你干什么，滚下去，要不然我报警了！”
秋莹脸色大变，抄起矿泉水瓶子，就往他身上没头没脑的乱敲。

> Chapter 1 A Chance Encounter at Rebirth (Page 1)
A harsh sudden braking sound sounded, and long black marks were dragged out on the ground.
The speed of the car dropped sharply, but it still hit Yin Dong, causing him to fly out.
Immediately, Yin Dong opened his eyes, looked around blankly, and found that the surrounding environment was very familiar. It was his hometown of Baishan Town that he had left for many years!
"Didn't I die? Why did I return to my hometown?"
Yin Dong murmured, and when he saw that he was wearing sportswear made of soiled chemical fiber material.
He sat up in excitement, hurriedly touched his trouser pocket, took out his mobile phone and opened it, his eyes fixed on the time and date on the screen - May 3rd, 2008!
"Is this really not a dream? Am I reborn?"
Looking at the cute baby photo on the screen saver, dusty memories suddenly swept over him, and Yin Dong's vision couldn't help but become blurred.
Back then, my beloved wife Axia abandoned her husband and son without saying goodbye?
The biological son was regarded as a disaster by the grandmother who believed the lies of the second aunt, and was sold by them?
This kind of pain and regret has even become his inner demon!
"Oh no, isn't today the day that my son Xiaobao was stolen? Xiaobao!"
A terrible thought flashed through Yin Dong's mind, his eyes turned red, and he stood up suddenly.
The beautiful car owner got out of the car to see what was going on. As soon as she finished asking, she saw Yin Dong standing up suddenly and took two steps back in fright. She said nervously: "You, you, you... ahem, shall I take you to the hospital?"
Yin Dong wanted to find his son now and had no intention of causing trouble to the car owner. After saying that, he was about to leave when he looked up and saw the other person's face, which felt like an electric shock.
This woman's fair oval face, big almond eyes, and her mouth always seemed to be smiling when she didn't speak... She was so familiar, it had haunted him in his dreams for so many years!
Yin Dong was confused. Did this happiness come too suddenly?
After he left this sad place in his previous life, he searched for his wife and children for many years, but to no avail.
Could it be that she has always stayed in Baishan Town and never left?
The beautiful car owner was about to step forward to help Yin Dong, but unexpectedly, Yin Dong hugged her and was shocked.
"Axia, you are finally back. I miss you so much——"
She was stunned, and then anger suddenly emerged. She stepped hard on Yin Dong's instep, took the opportunity to break free, and retreated continuously.
"Axia, you don't recognize me anymore? I am your husband Yin Dong!"
"My name is Qiu Ying, and I am not some damned Axia.
Hey, I'll just assume you've got the wrong person, don't come over here, or I'll call the police! "
Qiu Ying found that there was no one around, and she was about to get angry, but after a moment of hesitation, she decided to forget it.
She got into the car in embarrassment and quickly turned the steering wheel to drive away - the suspected guy was not injured anyway, so it was best not to continue to entangle him.
"Although the temperament and tone of voice are indeed different, they look exactly the same!"
Yin Dong scratched his hair, a series of questions popping up in his mind.
He still remembered that in his previous life, it was because of amnesia that A-Xia was taken in by his family homeless, and then fell in love with him for a long time... Thinking of this, he suddenly slapped his head, "Ignore it for now, it's important to save Xiaobao!"
He opened the door and quickly got into the car, sitting on the passenger seat.
"What are you doing, get out of here, or I'll call the police!"
Qiu Ying's face changed drastically, she picked up the mineral water bottle and knocked it on him mindlessly.
